title: Change is good
html:
Change is something that a lot of people resist; the status quo works for them because they know what to expect and what is expected of them.

When major change occurs, as it did on Saturday in New Zealand, people can be thrown for a while, nervous about what to expect and, even more so, of what is expected of them.

To make it easier though, it was great to see a decisive outcome to the election. As a result, we know who is in charge.

I feel sure that change is good for New Zealand and I am looking forward to seeing what happens over the next three years. Hopefully some of our brightest stars will cancel their tickets out of here.

Helen Clark has been a leader who really made her mark and let the world know where we are. My only grumble from Saturday night was the little dig she had at National during her speech. It marred what was, overall, a great speech by a dedicated politician.

Good luck to National and John Key: more inspiration please! We know we can do better if you let us.
